title: Childhood saucer over football field, Artek camp and army sightings
place_text: Football field; Artek camp near Mount Ayu-Dag, Crimea; Soviet army

tellings.quote: me. You know in childhood when we played football we saw a saucer hovering over the football field a few dozen boys watching it.

plain: A former president of a Russian republic, named Kiran Ilum Xenov in the transcript, says that as a boy playing football he and a few dozen other boys watched a saucer hover over the football field. He tells Michels this was one of several sightings in his life, along with others at Artek, a well-known Soviet children's summer camp near Mount Ayu-Dag in Crimea, and later during his service in the Soviet army.
